integrity.mathematical_evidence: Exact symbolic characteristic-polynomial identities, rank-two min-max argument, elementwise Loewner bounds, executable rational-arithmetic checks.
integrity.prior_relationship: The BRAS construction, contrast-dependent upper estimate, and Jacobi spectral bounds are credited to prior work; novelty concerns the sharp necessity/minimal grading reversal.
integrity.source_access: Primary BRAS article inspected in freely accessible full-text rendering. Older diagonal-source full text unavailable under institutional-access restrictions; abstract and independent local-element proof used.

scientific_limitations: Exact threshold is for three-cell periodic one-dimensional conforming linear elements with lengths (epsilon,1,1), 0<epsilon<=1.
At general fixed n>=3 the one-short-cell asymptotics hold; no dimension-uniform constant is asserted.
Eigenvalue-based generalized spectral condition numbers only, not Euclidean singular-value condition numbers or solve times.
No higher-order, nonperiodic, vector-valued, Dirichlet, or implementation-level conclusion is proved.
title: A sharp mesh-grading reversal for periodic \(P_1\) BRAS mass preconditioning
